en.title: Library Prefix Pairs
en.description:
Count ordered index pairs i≠j such that title i is a prefix of title j; different indices with identical titles also count.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: n (1≤n≤200000), followed by n lines of non-empty lowercase strings, each of length ≤1000, with total length ≤200000; the ranges are site-added to bound Trie memory.
en.output: Output the number of ordered pairs.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
